Answers of an imaginary licensed rating source, written by hand for the tests.

The field names follow the shape 2GIS documents for its Places API (`result.items[].reviews.general_rating`),
but none of these files was captured from a live call: no key and no agreement exist yet.
Before a real source is switched on, compare its real answer with `source-ok.json` and adjust
`ASTOR_RATINGS_<SOURCE>_RATING_PATH` if it differs.
